pendingApproval: Waiting for internal approval before it goes to the customer
waitingCustomer: Sent, waiting for the customer — share the link or record an answer received another way

fields.title: Variation title
fields.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Add a storeroom on the ground floor

list.title: Variations (VO)
list.needsContract: Sign the main contract first to create variations

empty.title: No variations yet
empty.hint: When the customer asks for a change after signing, create a variation here

lines.title: Variation lines
lines.manualHint: Pick an existing cost code, or leave it empty for a new item. A negative quantity removes work; sell prices are computed by the system

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.empty: No evidence yet — at least one item (or an answer through the link) is needed before recording an acceptance
evidence.notePlaceholder: Write a note, e.g. a summary of the talk with the customer

sandbox.title: Price with the calculators
sandbox.hint: Opens the calculators and the BOQ on the project's baseline. Change only what the variation changes, then save to let the system build the variation lines — the real project is not changed
sandbox.summary: Calculators changed {calculators} · BOQ lines edited {edits} · lines from the calculators {lines}

problems.baseline_not_locked: The BOQ baseline is not locked, so the calculators cannot price this variation
problems.not_draft: Only a draft variation can be changed

sandbox.bannerHint: Use the calculators and the BOQ as usual; nothing is saved to the project. Press "Save" to compute the variation lines
sandbox.cancelConfirm: Leave without saving the calculator changes?

response.title: Record the customer's answer
response.hint: For an answer given another way (phone, e-mail, signed copy). An acceptance needs at least one evidence item
response.name: Answered by

submit.hint: The VO number is issued (or internal approval is asked first) and the lines can no longer be changed
